The hook formula primitive encodes a set of psychological triggers that maximize engagement through conspiracy, contrarianism, and urgency. These are mathematically modeled as binary classifiers with temporal decay functions. The content format primitive leverages visual attention models to force engagement through structured presentation and payoff slides. The funnel mechanism uses comment volume as a proxy for user intent, triggering automated DM responses and subscription locks. All three primitives form a closed-loop system where engagement drives monetization, which in turn fuels further content production. The failure mode lies in the lack of verifiable performance metrics—this creates a trust gap that GSI can exploit by introducing calibrated probabilities and public receipts.
